name: Stripe
how_to_set: Stripe charges fees per payment, not a cloud bill; there is no cap to set.
Use restricted keys (only the permissions the app needs); keep live keys out of development.
Turn on Radar rules and rate-limit public checkout endpoints against card testing.
kill_switch: Roll (revoke) the API keys in Developers > API keys; deactivate payment links.
traps: Card-testing attacks on open checkout endpoints cause fees and disputes
Billing and Tax products add percentage fees
Live and test keys mixed up
